name: Mall Ceiling Panel Module
summary: A 1.2 m square suspended ceiling cassette with four recessed mineral-fibre-style panels, ivory T-grid and editable steel hangers.
description: A 1.2 m square suspended ceiling cassette with four recessed mineral-fibre-style panels, ivory T-grid and editable steel hangers.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry, Principled materials and seeded Pillow mineral-fibre artwork; no third-party models, artwork or fonts.

display.front_axis: Square ceiling; decorative face points toward Blender -Z / glTF -Y

assembly.instructions: Place whole roots on a 1.2 m glTF X/Z grid at the desired ceiling height Y. Root Y is the visible grid underside; hangers rise to Y+0.36. Quarter-turn Y rotations retain connector alignment. Each boundary contributes a 12 mm half-grid flange; do not add a duplicate border. Four connector empties are visual registration aids, not structural fittings.

material_notes: 25 independently editable closed meshes: four mineral-fibre-style panels, nine closed T-grid rails and twelve suspension pieces. Four connector empties. The original 256 x 256 texture is packed in source and embedded in GLB. No light emitter or electrical system is included.
accuracy_notes: Generic decorative mall ceiling concept for Singapore/Malaysia scenes. No acoustic, fire, electrical, structural, load-bearing, installation or building-code certification is claimed.

attribution.credit: Original geometry, materials and seeded mineral-fibre texture authored for Blender-3D-Gallery; no external artwork.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

quality_gate.scope: Local artifact. Existing elevated gallery camera initially shows the rear; underside is inspectable with orbit controls and supplied underside previews. No app UI or metadata schema extension. Desktop viewport evidence is not physical Android/iOS coverage.
